class.name: MaszynaMmdProvider
class.brief_description: Where the vehicles' MMD files are read from.
class.description: Whether an MMD file is there, what it says and when it last changed, by its absolute path. [MaszynaVehicleMmdManager] reads every MMD file, and every file one includes, through the provider it holds ([method MaszynaVehicleMmdManager.set_mmd_provider]) - [MaszynaFileMmdProvider], the disk's, unless a tool that keeps a vehicle's MMD elsewhere (an editor writing it of a description of its own) hands in one deriving from this class and overriding [method _file_exists], [method _read_file] and [method _get_modified_time]. Called on the vehicles' worker threads.

method.name: _file_exists
method.description: Returns whether the file at [param abs_path] is there.

method.name: _get_modified_time
method.description: Returns when the file at [param abs_path] last changed, as [method FileAccess.get_modified_time] tells it; 0 for none.

method.name: _read_file
method.description: Returns what the file at [param abs_path] says; empty for none.

method.name: file_exists
method.description: Returns whether the file at [param abs_path] is there.

method.name: get_modified_time
method.description: Returns when the file at [param abs_path] last changed; 0 for none.

method.name: read_file
method.description: Returns what the file at [param abs_path] says; empty for none.
